_comment: What the campaign's arms EXECUTE differently, declared BEFORE any paper cell (incident-graph-ladder-confound-20260916, rule 1). verify_execution_differences.py reads every arm's boot snapshot and refuses the campaign on any difference not listed here. Values are per arm; a field absent from an arm's entry must be equal across all arms.

upstream.reason: literal SGLang default ladder on 80 GB (T1 column)

vskipper.reason: design: the fork captures 4x max_bs (vpipe/common.py); its router/projector weights shrink the K/V pool by <1.5 % (against the treatment)

fork_default.reason: any arm served from the fork tree (RandomSkip sweep mocks, ablation arms, Qwen arms): the same coverage ladder as vskipper and the same router/projector HBM cost
